title: chore(scripts): the engine codemod starts the facet a section anchor names, so update can move (R11)
body:

_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9CjeUv15kvivj1rNCQgSB9h)_
Refs #30020
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Part A of #30020 §5 item E6 (`update`): the codemod capability only. The `update` move itself is part B, a separate PR after this one lands (seat ruling: split from one branch).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：引擎拆分脚本 `scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs` 的 `--members` 一遍新增规则 R11——某个分节在首遍拆分时一个方法都没搬出（如 `update`），其分节锚点已登记模块名但磁盘上没有该模块时，第一次搬移会按首遍的写法新建该 facet 模块及其宿主接线。
- 为什么改：#30020 的 E6 要把 `update` 搬出 `engine.ts`，但原脚本只会往已写好的 facet 里加，拒绝新建（“never starts one”），E6 卡在这一步。
- 风险与回滚：只改一个仓库脚本，不发布、不改运行时代码；首遍输出不变（自测 232 条原有用例全绿）。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs` 的 `planMembers` / `generateMembers` / `verifyMembers` 中标注 R11 的三段，以及新增的 `startedModuleText` 等辅助函数。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs --self-test`，预期最后一行 `250 cases in 15 batteries pass`；再跑 `node scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs --members update`（只做计划不写盘），预期打印 `engine-update.ts: update (2106 body lines)` 和 undo proof `does rebuild ... byte-for-byte`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs`, the fourth pass (`--members`):

- **R11, a facet the anchor names and the first pass never wrote.** A section whose every method a stay rule held when `engine.ts` was split has a row in `SECTION_ANCHORS` and no module on disk (`['update', 'Update', 'engine-update.ts']` today). Before this PR `--members update` refused with "this pass adds to a written facet, never starts one". Now the first move into such a section:
  - writes the module exactly as the first pass writes one for those members (`moduleText`), routed onto the statics route when one of them reads a non-public static (the first pass's rule). A binding `engine.ts` imports from the leaf renders from the leaf, as the leaf's top-level name it was when the first pass ran (`startedModuleText`);
  - makes the first pass's `engine.ts` edits for a facet: the facet import under its comment, in section order among the facet imports; and, when a body reads the class, its host in the hosts import (sorted), its install call in the install block (sorted by host name);
  - adds the host's two lines to `engine-facet-hosts.ts`, which is `hostsTexts` of one module more.
  - A constructor never starts a facet (refuses); a name R11 generates that `engine.ts` already binds refuses; starting a host without the hosts module the first pass wrote refuses.
- **The undo proof** (`--members --verify --base REF`) treats a receiving module absent at base as started: the head module must be exactly the rendering of a stay-rule reading of the base members, and deleting it plus removing the facet import, the host from the hosts import, the install call and the hosts-module lines must rebuild the base `engine.ts` and `engine-facet-hosts.ts` byte for byte.
- `moduleText` learns R1's identity-port interface line (`facadeIfaceLine`). No first-pass mover reads `facade` (bare `this` stays in the first pass), so the first pass's output is unchanged.
- The pass's header comment now names R11 next to R10.

No new public key, error code or route.

## Tests

- `node scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs --self-test`: base `8031f49d` 232 cases in 14 batteries; head 250 cases in 15 batteries, all pass. The new battery `a facet the anchor names and the first pass never wrote (fourth pass, #30020 R11)` (18 cases, floor pinned at 18) builds the identity fixture with a section whose two methods both read `this` bare, so the first pass writes no module for it, then: plan starts the module; the moves prove; two runs are byte-identical; the started module, the facet import, the hosts import, the install call and the hosts module are each the first pass's text; and five negative controls fail (an extra line in the started module, the statics paragraph removed, a hosts module without the host, a duplicate facet import, a missing install call), plus four refusals.
- Trial on the real tree (not committed here; it is part B): `node scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs --members update --write` writes `engine-update.ts` (2253 lines), edits `engine.ts` (8692 → 6597 lines) and `engine-facet-hosts.ts` (+2), and the undo proof passes. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck` on that trial tree: exit 0 (tsc clean, test layer 39 files / 233 errors / 64 pinned signatures held). The tree was then restored (`git diff HEAD` empty).
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs`: exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- Part B will be about 4,500 changed lines (the `update` body alone is 2,106 lines, moved), so it lands only after a `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` approval under the 3,000-line rule; splitting this codemod change out keeps the capability reviewable on its own.
- Changeset: none, labelled `skip-changeset`. The diff is a root `scripts/` file, which no package's `files[]` ships.
